name: Issue UCAN Token
description: Creates a venue-signed UCAN capability token for resources controlled by this venue or one of its managed custodial users. The venue is the issuer. Self-sovereign DID owners must sign UCANs with their own key using a client SDK. The token grants the audience (aud) the specified capabilities (att). Set exp to a future Unix timestamp for a finite lifetime; omitted exp or explicit exp:null mints a genuinely non-expiring token with an explicit null claim. With prf, the venue itself passes on part of grants made to it: the token carries them as proof, every att entry must be covered by one of them, and exp cannot outlive it.

aud.description: Audience DID — who receives this capability (e.g. did:key:z6MkBob...)

att.description: Attenuations — array of {with, can} capability pairs for venue-controlled resources

exp.description: Optional expiry as a future integer Unix timestamp in seconds. Omit or set to null for a genuinely non-expiring token; the emitted token carries an explicit exp:null claim.

prf.description: Optional proofs: UCAN JWTs granting this venue the capabilities it passes on. Only the venue itself may supply them. Omitted or empty mints a root.

output.description: Complete signed UCAN token (header, payload, sig)
